headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: Revenue, EBITDA and PAT rose by 64%, 36% and 21% respectively.  Order book and Order Intake: Order intake registered robust growth of 86% YoY to stand at Rs ~41bn.
Key order wins in the quarter were the Fatehgarh III STATCOM project, grid automation for a leading utility in Southern India, 33/220 KV AIS substation in Karnataka and 220 KV switchyard in Odisha.

Semiconductor and precision manufacturing industries are generating healthy demand for the company’s offerings.  HVDC Update: Management mentioned that revenue execution in the Bhadla-Fatehpur HVDC and the Khavda to Nagpur HVDC stands at 5% and 10% respectively.

The management stated that the company is fully ready for such a complex and massive project from an engineering standpoint.  Data Centres: The management asserted that no part of the order backlog comprises of US Data Centre orders.
valuation: The company envisages strong growth outlook for data centres in the near term.  Valuation: We remain structurally positive on Hitachi Energy and its solid growth prospects owing to the robust momentum in electrification not only in India but also globally.
Data Centres  The company has secured multiple orders from global hyperscalers and domestic colocation operators.

Its data centre-related order wins are primarily across India and Asia-Pacific markets, including Southeast Asia, with no US data centre orders in the existing backlog.  The grid-to-rack solution (grid connection to rack) will be manufactured in India and confirmed that the solutions will be manufactured upon receipt of orders.  Management sees no slowdown in its target geographies.
